metadata.order: Per workload: 3 fresh process pairs, alternating AB/BA
metadata.head: 3ba52a1d5baf1d7a45f982383dfceafbe5bfb342

workloads.name: text/patterns
workloads.source:
-- Find all three maximal digit runs, compiling the Pattern during Load.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put every match of <digits> in "a12 b345 c6" into hits
    add the length of hits to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run
